messages:
zoe (DevEx): Small prerelease bug: sampleapp shows duplicate "start" events when rotating the screen during an active chunked generate call. Seen on Pixel and Samsung, Android 12-14.

zoe (DevEx): Repro steps: 1) start chunked POST /v1/generate from sampleapp 2) rotate device while upload is in progress 3) server logs two start_token entries for same session id.

zoe (DevEx): Minimal okhttp config we use in SDK:
```kotlin
OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .callTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
  .build()
```

eli (Android): likely cause: our RetryInterceptor calls newCall().execute() on IOException. With streaming bodies that are one-shot, that re-executes the same payload and duplicates the start.

eli (Android): snippet in SDK:
```kotlin
try { return chain.proceed(req) } catch (ioe: IOException) { return chain.call().client().newCall(req).execute() }
```

raj (QA): I can reproduce on emulator: adb rotate mid-send -> dup start_token. Will add CI task that rotates and asserts server saw exactly one start.

sam (Platform): short term: mark streaming endpoints non-retryable in the SDK (turn off retryOnConnectionFailure for streaming client), and update RetryInterceptor to detect chunked/unbuffered bodies (contentLength==-1 or Transfer-Encoding header) and avoid automatic retry.

zoe (DevEx): Agreed. I'll open a small PR: guard in interceptor + sampleapp test for rotation and for quick network blips. Also add doc note: "Do not enable automatic retries for chunked/streaming endpoints; use idempotency headers if you need retries."

replay-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1833 - "Rotation/net blip causes RetryInterceptor to duplicate streaming requests"

eli (Android): long-term: server-side dedupe on session-start or an official X-Idempotency-Key header is probably the more robust solution. For now let's land the guard and tests.

zoe (DevEx): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
